spec.description: RestAPI (me-java-restapi) action traffic, latency, errors, usage and pod resources.

spec.title: RestAPI Action Rate
spec.description: Average RestAPI /action calls per second, computed over the last $interval (e.g. 10m = avg req/s in that window, not total calls in 10m)

spec.title: RestAPI Action Error Rate
spec.description: Fraction of RestAPI actions with status 4xx/5xx/error (error req/s ÷ total req/s over $interval)

spec.title: Average latency
spec.description: Mean action duration over the last $interval.

spec.title: RestAPI Actions Total (selected range)
spec.description: Cumulative count of RestAPI actions in the dashboard time range ($__range). Not req/s — absolute number of calls.

spec.title: Failed actions (selected range)
spec.description: Absolute number of failed actions (4xx, 5xx, error) in the dashboard time range.

spec.title: Active users (selected range)
spec.description: Distinct users that called at least one action in the dashboard time range.

spec.title: Most requested aliases
spec.description: Top aliases by avg calls/sec over the last $interval

spec.title: Most active users (RestAPI)
spec.description: Top users by avg calls/sec over the last $interval

spec.title: Action rate by status
spec.description: Calls per second split by result status.

spec.title: Actions per $interval
spec.description: Number of actions in each $interval bucket.

spec.title: Average RestAPI Action latency
spec.description: Mean action duration in seconds by alias (sum/count over $interval)

spec.title: Slowest aliases (selected range)
spec.description: Top 15 aliases by mean duration over the dashboard time range.

spec.title: Time spent by alias (selected range)
spec.description: Total seconds spent executing each alias in the dashboard time range: where the RestAPI spends its time.

spec.title: Failed actions by alias
spec.description: Failed calls per second (4xx, 5xx, error) by alias.

spec.title: Failed actions by status
spec.description: Failed calls per second by status.

spec.title: Most failing aliases (selected range)
spec.description: Aliases with the most failed actions in the dashboard time range.

spec.title: Error logs
spec.description: me-java-restapi log lines matching ERROR.

spec.title: RestAPI Actions by alias (selected range)
spec.description: Cumulative action count per alias in the dashboard time range ($__range)

spec.title: RestAPI Actions by user (selected range)
spec.description: Cumulative action count per username in the dashboard time range ($__range)

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: CPU cores used by me-java-restapi containers.

spec.title: Memory working set
spec.description: Memory used by me-java-restapi containers.

spec.title: JVM heap usage
spec.description: Heap used vs max for me-java-restapi.

spec.title: Container restarts
spec.description: me-java-restapi container restarts.
